answer: Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 74 identities means 74 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Because the ledge pair is tracked in the grove ledger, the echo audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Full reward demands answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 36%. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
